renew.description: A currently active session token to extend, instead of creating a new one.

hostnames.description: Lowercase hostnames to serve. Each must have a link.jetbridge.route record in the caller's repo.

errors.name: HostnameNotBound
errors.description: _jetbridge.<hostname> does not have exactly one did= TXT value, or that value is not did=<caller's DID>.

errors.name: RouteNotFound
errors.description: The caller's repo has no valid link.jetbridge.route record for the hostname.

errors.name: RouteNotForProvider
errors.description: The route record for the hostname does not name this provider.

errors.name: PolicyNotAccepted
errors.description: The route record's acceptedPolicy for this provider is not one the provider accepts now. Show the user the provider's current policy, and ask them to accept it.

errors.name: ApprovalRequired
errors.description: Admission is approval and the caller has no unexpired link.jetbridge.approval record. Wait for the record to appear, then retry.

errors.name: Denied
errors.description: Permission for this host is not granted. A retry will likely not help.

errors.name: UpstreamFailure
errors.description: The provider could not check the hostname. A retry may help.

token.description: Opaque random token bound to the caller's DID.

refused.description: Requested hostnames that the token does not grant, each with the reason. The token grants the rest. Absent when it grants them all.

expiresAt.description: After this time the tunnel accepts no new logins or proxies with the token, and renew cannot extend it.

main.description: Request a session token from a Provider, to let a tunnel serve the given hostname(s).

error.description: Why this hostname was refused: one of this procedure's errors.
